id: title:TueHaulund:refuse experiment scanners and explain missing answers in the workflow step

review.posthog_relevance: Adds compatibility guard to workflow execution path and error-return path to prevent workflows from incorrectly invoking Experiment scanners, which require variant sampling not available in workflow-triggered sessions.
review.reason: Adds workflow-scanner compatibility checks and error messages to workflow execution and error-return paths. This could prevent workflows from incorrectly invoking Experiment scanners, which require variant sampling not available in workflow-triggered sessions.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of workflow-triggered sessions and Experiment scanners requiring variant sampling, which is not independently verified in the provided observations. The score is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness improvement, not on unverified adoption or systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a workflow-scanner compatibility check and its error message.
observations.posthog_connection: Workflow execution path: P1.F1.H2 adds a guard that rejects workflow-triggered scans of Experiment scanners, while P1.F1.H3 adds the same check to the error-return path.
